argv:
set -euo pipefail
RESULT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent-runtime/results/integral-3b1b-ref-bilibili"
WORK=/tmp/ref3b1b
rm -rf "$WORK" "$RESULT"; mkdir -p "$WORK" "$RESULT"; cd "$WORK"
python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade yt-dlp Pillow
REF_URL='https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV14x411Y7B5'
yt-dlp --no-playlist --no-warnings -f 'bestvideo[height<=480]+bestaudio/best[height<=480]/best' --merge-output-format mp4 -o 'reference.%(ext)s' "$REF_URL" >yt-dlp.log 2>&1
REF=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'reference.*' | head -n1)
test -s "$REF"
for spec in '00:08:40 ref_area.png' '00:09:50 ref_refine.png' '00:11:40 ref_ftc.png' '00:13:10 ref_geometry.png' '00:16:30 ref_recap.png'; do ts=${spec%% *}; out=${spec#* }; ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -ss "$ts" -i "$REF" -frames:v 1 "$RESULT/$out"; done
python3 - <<'PYS'
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
fs=sorted(Path(__import__('os').environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']).joinpath('agent-runtime/results/integral-3b1b-ref-bilibili').glob('ref_*.png'))
cards=[]
for p in fs:
 im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB'); im.thumbnail((480,270)); cards.append((p.name,im.copy()))
sh=Image.new('RGB',(960,310*((len(cards)+1)//2)),'black'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
for i,(n,im) in enumerate(cards):
 x=(i%2)*480; y=(i//2)*310; sh.paste(im,(x,y)); d.text((x+8,y+275),n,fill='white')
sh.save(Path(__import__('os').environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])/'agent-runtime/results/integral-3b1b-ref-bilibili/contact_sheet.jpg',quality=92)
PYS
cp yt-dlp.log "$RESULT/"
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of json "$REF" > "$RESULT/reference_probe.json"
